subject: Invoice 8921 — payment anchor proposal & VAT/withholding clarification
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novusbiotech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice 8921 — payment anchor proposal & VAT/withholding clarification

Elena —

Thanks for taking my call earlier. Attaching Invoice 8921 for the dec Q4 usage. I understand Novus is requesting additional detail on VAT and the potential application of local withholding tax given the services and cross-border flows.

Two immediate asks so we can unblock collections this week:
- Can you confirm whether Novus will be able to move a payment to the host entity in USD, or if you need the EU entity to accept split remits?
- Do you need Redwood to provide a WHOLE tax pack (certs, SOC2 excerpts, and a vendor tax declaration) or just a withholding-agreement addendum for the treasury team?

Proposal to keep this live while you collect approvals: a staged payment anchor — 40% on receipt, 40% in 30 days, 20% on 60 days — with full VAT evidence provided by Redwood once you confirm the remit entity. We can also show the remittance flow we use for marketplace customers (see attached remit-schedule_8921.xlsx). If Novus can commit to the first anchor installment by next Friday, we will pause formal dunning escalation.

I copied Marcus (finance) for visibility and Laura (CS collections) who can help on the operational side.

Attachments: Invoice_8921.pdf, remit-schedule_8921.xlsx

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0149

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novusbiotech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Jimenez <carlos.jimenez@novusbiotech.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Invoice 8921 — payment anchor proposal & VAT/withholding clarification

Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear proposal. A few points from our side after a quick run with treasury:
- Novus prefers to remit from our EU entity (Novus Biotech EU). We will need an explicit statement that VAT will be invoiced to the EU entity and confirmation that Redwood will not charge local US withholding on the amount once we remit from the EU entity.
- Our treasury requires vendor tax evidence showing Redwood's tax residency and any treaty position you are relying on for withholding relief. If you have a standard pack, please send.
- CFO (Carlos) wants to avoid any contingent payment exposure across entities. He asked whether we can structure the staged payments as separate invoices mapped to the same project (so our AP can book against our EU ledger without cross-entity suspense).

If you can provide the tax pack and separate invoice proposal, we'll aim to approve the 40% anchor by EOD Thursday (US time). Without that, the CFO will push payment to Jan and we'll need to move to a more formal dunning cadence.

—Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Treasury | Novus Biotech
elena.morales@novusbiotech.com | +44 20 7946 0123

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novusbiotech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice 8921 — payment anchor proposal & VAT/withholding clarification

Elena —

Understood and thanks for the detail. Quick responses inline, followed by next steps.

- Entity/remit: We can reissue the invoice(s) to Novus Biotech EU as separate invoices tied to the same subscription line. That will make AP posting straightforward.

- Withholding/VAT: Redwood will provide a tax evidence pack (attached: tax-evidence-pack.zip) that includes: our tax residency certificate, standard treaty summary for US↔EU services, and an excerpted SOC2 statement for controls around invoicing/tax. This should meet your treasury checklist; if Carlos needs a signed W-8BEN-E variant or local equivalent, let us know — we can escalate to legal.

- Operational: Laura will prepare the three reissued invoice PDFs (40/40/20) and a short remit SOP that shows ledger posting suggestions for Novus EU and the mapping we recommend. Marcus — please confirm you are OK to approve reissue and we will hold dunning until the anchor payment posts.

If Novus commits to the 40% anchor by end of Thursday US times, we'll mark the account as "in-payment" and defer any escalation to leadership. If the anchor does not post, we will start a staged dunning sequence and may need to loop in execs for a payment bridge ask.

Attachments: tax-evidence-pack.zip

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0149

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 24 Dec 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Invoice 8921 — payment anchor proposal & VAT/withholding clarification

Kim / Laura —

Forwarding Novus thread after Kim's updates. Quick internal plan before we close the loop:
1) Approve reissue: I approve issuing 3 invoices (40/40/20) to Novus Biotech EU — CFO alignment looks feasible if we provide the tax pack.
2) Credit hold policy: if anchor posts, we lift the automated credit hold and set a 10-day monitoring flag (Finance will track). If not, escalate to a short exec ask (Markus/Kim K).
3) Exec ask template: Laura, please draft a one-pager for COO/CFO outlining the shortfall (amount, proposed bridge, business impact) so we can move quickly if needed.

I'll review Laura's draft once ready. Good job moving this proactively — keep pressure on the anchor without threatening legal action; focus on pragmatic remediation.

Marcus Lin
Director, Enterprise Finance | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0199
